### Bible Pathways - February 26, 2006
Author: Bible Pathways
Site: Crosswalk.com
URL: https://www.crosswalk.com/devotionals/biblepathways/bible-pathways-february-26-2006-1380109.html
Passage: Numbers 31:1-17
Points:
- The Midianites harmed Israel not through open warfare, but through seductive idolatry and compromise at Baal-peor.
- God directed Moses to send an army alongside Phinehas to carry out divine judgment on Midian.
- Balaam pursued wealth and social standing among the Midianites, ultimately sharing in their fatal judgment.
- Wishing to die the death of the righteous is meaningless when daily choices are ruled by greed and deception.
- The righteous defeat of the Midianite kings foreshadows Christ executing true judgment against all wickedness.
